Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi there,
Suppose my Herald of Topeth got a Textbook Damnation.

Now, my Herald plays a card requiring Daimoinon (at inferior, since he cannot play it at superior). That card's printed cost is 1 blood (for instance: Conflagration, Greater Curse, ..)

Does my Herald burn any blood to pay that card?

I think he does - even though Conflagration (...) sees him as a vampire, the Textbook only sees him as an ally, and thus doesn't reduce the cost of the card.

Thanks

Pascal

~~

Herald of Topheth
Cardtype: 	Ally
Clan: 	Baali
Cost: 	3 pool
Demon with 5 life. 3 strength, 1 bleed, flight [FLIGHT].
The Herald may enter combat with a ready minion controlled by another Methuselah as a (D) action. The Herald may play cards requiring basic Daimoinon [dai], Potence [pot] and/or Presence [pre] as a vampire with a capacity of 5. Any cost in blood is paid with his life. If a card would give him blood, give him life instead. If the Herald has less than 5 life during your untap phase, add 1 life. During your influence phase, burn 1 pool or burn the Herald.

The Textbook Damnation
Cardtype: 	Equipment
Cost: 	1 pool
Unique equipment.
The vampire with this equipment has superior Daimoinon [DAI] and is infernal. Cards that require Daimoinon [dai] cost this vampire 2 less blood [()]. During your master phase, if this vampire is tapped, burn this equipment.

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body: Correct. Textbook has no effect on Herald, since Herald is not "this vampire".
